title: Inertia
content: Inertia is the natural property of a body which resists the change of its state of motion.
e: Inertia is the natural property of a body which resists the change of its state of motion. Inertia is the natural resistance of a body to a change of motion.

title: Newton's First Law of Motion
content: When no net external force acts upon it, a particle at rest will remain at rest and a particle in motion at a constant velocity will continue to move with the same constant velocity.
e: When no net external force acts upon it, a particle at rest will remain at rest and a particle in motion at a constant velocity will continue to move with the same constant velocity. Zero net force means constant velocity, including staying at rest.

title: Newton's Second Law of Motion
content: The net external force acting upon a particle is equal to the product of the mass and the acceleration of the particle.
e: The net external force acting upon a particle is equal to the product of the mass and the acceleration of the particle. Net force and acceleration point the same way, and a equals F over m.

title: Newton's Third Law of Motion
content: Whenever two particles interact, the force exerted by the second on the first is equal in magnitude and opposite in direction to the force exerted by the first on the second.
e: Whenever two particles interact, the force exerted by the second on the first is equal in magnitude and opposite in direction to the force exerted by the first on the second. Action and reaction are equal and opposite, and they act on two different bodies.

title: Momentum
content: Momentum of a body is defined as the product of the mass of the body and its velocity.
e: Momentum of a body is defined as the product of the mass of the body and its velocity. Momentum is mass times velocity, so it is directed. Velocity is directed. Speed is the size of that velocity.

title: Weight
content: The attracting force of the earth acting on a body is defined as the weight of the body.
e: The attracting force of the earth acting on a body is defined as the weight of the body. Weight is the gravitational pull of the Earth on a body, a downward force. Weight is mg, a force toward Earth's centre, not the same as mass.

title: Mass
content: Mass is the quantity of matter in a body.
e: Mass is the quantity of matter in a body. Mass is the quantity of matter, a scalar that does not depend on location.
